concern_summary: This concern deals with the functionality for checking the status of the delayed submission feature, determining if it is enabled based on specific conditions.
This concern focuses on managing the selection and display of different auto reporting frequencies for a workspace policy, enabling users to choose from various reporting options.

This concern pertains to managing specific time delays related to processes and animations within the application, ensuring that actions are executed in a staggered or synchronized manner to enhance performance and user experience.
